caption: The drawing consists of two distinct parts positioned vertically on a plain, light beige background. At the top center of the image is a small, square pencil sketch of a jar or vase, which contains a minimalist outline of five oval leaves and a central circular form representing a stylized plant motif. Below this, occupying most of the lower portion, is a long rectangular section featuring a more detailed rendering of a similar plant. This section is drawn with black and grey ink, showing a central stem with five large, oval leaves arranged around it, each shaded to depict depth and curvature. There is a signature, “Yolande Delasser,” in the lower right corner of the larger drawing. Both drawings are simple and monochromatic, utilizing shades of black, grey, and the beige of the background.
title: Crock
